text: [low, gravelly] Nine a.m. The kid took a day off. For a package.
[casually, to himself] Nine to five. Easy.
[low, gravelly] No shower. No lunch. He refreshed the app forty-one times.
[muttering, reasoning with himself] He's not coming. [pause] Thirty seconds. I'll be thirty seconds.
[low, gravelly] Same chair. Same door. Tomorrow.
